note: FINRA consolidated short interest: the short positions broker-dealers carry for customers and themselves in each stock as of the settlement date, reported twice a month and published about a week later. Days to cover = short position ÷ average daily volume, as FINRA computes it. A position is a snapshot, not a trade; a stock split (flagged) changes the share counts.
